results.title: Black Gold: The Story of Israeli Hip Hop
results.original_title: זהב שחור: סיפורו של ההיפ הופ הישראלי
results.overview: Hip-Hop in the Holy Tongue – a raw and heartbreaking story about language, identity, and belonging.

results.title: SADO
results.overview: During a small celebration between three gay roommates, the arrival of a stranger met through a dating app destabilizes their intimacy, turning desire into a dangerous game of trust.

results.title: Wayward
results.overview: After the death of his father, John Holden embarks on a road trip across the state in an attempt to reconnect with the woman he still loves, however, his efforts at reconciliation will lead him feeling more lost than ever.

results.title: Горизонт, прожектор, яблоко, пепел, кочегар
results.overview: Forty-year-old Pasha arrives at an inconspicuous workshop on the outskirts of town and gives the shopkeeper a secret code: "Horizon, spotlight, apple, ash, stoker." This password opens a gateway to the past—a chance to see someone who can never be brought back. But first, Pasha must recall something he himself had long forgotten.

results.title: ATEEZ [LIGHT THE WAY] IN CINEMAS
results.overview: One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change. ATINY has vanished. As if under a spell, ATEEZ wanders through a dreamlike wasteland, into a collapsing world engulfed in flames, and into the Dark City veiled in dense fog. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY.

results.title: Tragic Villain
results.overview: After the devastating loss of their infant daughter, Maria and Avery Brooks struggle to survive the quiet devastation that grief leaves behind. Once vibrant and full of life, Maria retreats into silence, while Avery-desperate to fix what feels irreparably broken-searches for any solution that might restore the woman he loves. As outside help enters their home, fragile emotions begin to shift in unexpected ways. What starts as an attempt to heal slowly exposes buried loneliness, unmet needs, and dangerous vulnerabilities. Love becomes complicated.

results.title: The Floaters
results.overview: Struggling musician Nomi accepts a last-resort job from her overachiever best friend Mara: mentoring misfit campers, the “Floaters,” at their childhood Jewish summer camp. As the camp struggles to survive amidst competition with a longtime rival, Nomi, the Floaters, and Mara must overcome their differences to bring the community together and save the camp.

results.title: Tasty Morsels
results.overview: A short film that poetically explores the sterile landscape of music consumption in the streaming era.

results.title: Sports Heaven: The Birth of ESPN
results.original_title: Sports Heaven: The Birth of ESPN
results.overview: Follows Bill Rasmussen and his team as they create ESPN in 1978, transforming a bold vision of 24/7 sports broadcasting from a risky venture in Bristol, Connecticut into a network that revolutionized sports media.

results.title: City of Masks
results.overview: Ambition, obsession, and lost love collide in a haunted West End theatre where a disfigured composer, a rising star, and a jealous rival fight for control of a mysterious musical-and the masked legacy that threatens to destroy them all.

results.title: Casi Algo
results.overview: In a forgotten desert ghost town, a young man follows the fleeting presence of a mysterious woman, confronting the line between love, projection, and the truths we choose to believe.

results.title: I'm Gonna Kill You
results.overview: In the distant future, inside an ‘all gay colony’, Cal and Spector, two paired lovers, fighting an internal battle – where remaining colony members ultimately pay the price of their twisted games.

results.title: Дарующая счастье
results.overview: In the dense forests of the Ramon region, where even the echoes recall ancient legends, three brave brothers set out on a journey in search of a winged miracle—a bird that grants wishes. But she has no magic wand, and every wish she makes drains her powers. The brothers must navigate secret paths and understand: happiness is not a trophy. It can only be shared. A new life for the fairy tale by Voronezh storyteller Anna Kupriyanovna Baryshnikova for those who believe in miracles.

results.title: Hard Time Lover
results.overview: Miguel tells Joana about his previous night.

results.title: God of Mischief
results.overview: When a cheeky 10-year-old boy sets his sights on playing Loki in the school play, his over-the-top confidence costs him the role, but he hatches a mischievous plan to prove he's the real god of mischief after all.

results.title: Pastures of the Gods
results.overview: The film's central premise is that a person only truly understands their true nature in extreme situations. The harsh conditions of the wild Pamir Mountains, where the film's main action unfolds, reveal the deepest foundations of the protagonists' personalities and motivations, forcing them to "wake up" from the mindless daily grind of the big city and make a crucial choice that can mean the difference between life and death. It is here, in the Pamir Mountains, at an altitude of several thousand meters, far from civilization, that a person understands who they are. And receives what they deserve...

results.title: The Cure - Open'er Festival 2026
results.overview: The Cure headlined the Open'er Festival on July 3, 2026, performing on the Orange Main Stage in Gdynia, Poland. Set Highlights include "Friday I'm in Love", "Boys Don't Cry", "Lovesong", "Push", and "In Between Days"

results.title: Everything Will Be Totally Fine
results.overview: In 2016, filmmaker Sam Baron asked people to predict the future. Ten years later, he revisited the footage to see what they got right about Trump, Brexit, climate change and the world we live in today. What he discovered was a far more personal story...

results.title: Mood Swings
results.overview: A coming of age drama about three different teen characters struggling to get by in their home town.  The first named Matthew is kicked out of his house and forced to find a job to support himself, the second named Noah is a hot shot basketball player who suffers an injury and can’t fulfill his scholarship to play on the college team, and the third named Eric is a party animal type who’s bad habits are leading him down a dark path that he may never get out of.
